releaseNotes:
• Anti-Clip DSP Voice Audio Fix: Strictly bounds TTS pitch [0.88–1.12] and speech rate [0.90–1.10], applies transient audio focus ducking with 0.88x digital headroom, and sequences payment chime before voice output to eliminate speaker crackling and distortion
• Upgraded Control Center UI: Redesigned Settings Hub with gradient daemon telemetry card, featured Voices & Sound Playground card, and refined system module cards
• Voices & Sound Studio Playground: Live 9-bar dynamic equalizer, clean anti-clip Pitch & Speed trim sliders (-6% to +6%), quick provider/amount presets, Chime + Voice sequence tester, and real-time DSP telemetry
